name: Spaghetti Pomodoro
description: Classic al dente spaghetti in a light tomato sauce made from ripe tomatoes, garlic, and fresh basil, finished with extra virgin olive oil.

name: Tagliatelle al Pesto
description: Fresh tagliatelle tossed in aromatic basil pesto with pine nuts, parmesan cheese, and olive oil.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
description: Penne pasta in a spicy tomato sauce with chili, garlic, and parsley – a bold flavor inspired by Roman cuisine.

name: Fusilli with Cream Sauce
description: Fusilli pasta in a creamy parmesan sauce with freshly ground black pepper, smooth and delicate in flavor.

name: Ravioli (Ricotta & Spinach)
description: Delicate ravioli filled with ricotta and spinach, served with sage butter and grated parmesan.

name: Linguine alle Vongole
description: Linguine with clams in a light white wine sauce with garlic, parsley, and olive oil.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Spaghetti in a creamy sauce made with egg yolks, pecorino romano, and crispy pancetta, seasoned with freshly ground black pepper.

name: Farfalle with Salmon
description: Farfalle pasta with salmon pieces in a delicate cream sauce with dill and a hint of lemon.

name: Gnocchi with Butter and Sage
description: Soft potato gnocchi sautéed in butter with crispy sage and topped with grated parmesan.

name: Tagliolini with Truffle
description: Thin tagliolini pasta in a creamy sauce with freshly grated black truffle and parmesan.

name: Orecchiette with Vegetables
description: Orecchiette pasta with seasonal vegetables, olive oil, garlic, and a touch of chili, finished with parmesan.

name: Lasagne
description: Layered lasagna with Bolognese sauce, béchamel, and baked mozzarella – a classic Italian recipe.
